The House GOP tax bill is a classic example of D.C. math—steal from working families to fund handouts for the elite. The Fair Tax Act (H.R.25) flips this script by abolishing the IRS and replacing income taxes with a 23% national sales tax. Under H.R.25, every dollar earned stays in your paycheck until you choose to spend it, with monthly prebates protecting essentials for lower-income households.

The current system lets bureaucrats pick winners (billionaires) and losers (you). The Fair Tax exposes the true cost of government while ending audit harassment.

If Congress really cared about fairness, they’d pass H.R.25 instead of rigging the game for their donors.
